✅ ① Net은 양방향 매체로서 상업적 거래뿐 아니라 개인의 창작과 소통에도 폭넓게 사용된다
❌ ② 전통 매체가 곧 인터넷을 대체할 것이다 — 본문 반대
❌ ③ 개인 창작물은 저작권 보호가 어렵다 — 언급 없음
❌ ④ 기업은 데이터베이스 보안을 강화해야 한다 — 무관

ch: Net은 양방향 매체로서 상업적 거래뿐 아니라 개인의 창작과 소통에도 폭넓게 사용된다
전통 매체가 곧 인터넷을 대체할 것이다

questions.passage: The Net differs from most of the mass media it replaces in an obvious and very important way: it's bidirectional. We can __________ through the network as well as receive them, which has made the system all the more useful. The ability to exchange information online, to upload as well as download, has turned the Net into a thoroughfare for business and commerce. With a few clicks, people can search virtual catalogues, place orders, track shipments, and update information in corporate databases. But the Net doesn't just connect us with businesses; it connects us with one another. It's a personal broadcasting medium as well as a commercial one. Millions of people use it to distribute their own digital creations, in the form of blogs, videos, photos, songs, and podcasts, as well as to critique, edit, or otherwise modify the creations of others.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오.
"네트워크를 통해 메시지를 보내다"
[조건] (1) send, messages, through, the, network를 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 5단어로 쓸 것 (5단어)

det.korean: 네트워크를 통해 메시지를 보내다
det.analysis: ✅ send messages through the network: send(보내다) + messages + through + the + network = 5단어
